summary: Satya, co-host of Melanin Millennials, detailed her experience leaving Shout Out Network (SON) after discovering they had taken ownership of their podcast without her knowledge or consent. Initially invited to create a podcast with SON, she alleges verbal agreements regarding ownership were broken, leading to her removal from the show and denial of her rights. She expresses disappointment over lack of transparency and agency and intends to reclaim ownership of her content.
